report_tiers.ladder, child widths, check: evaluation tier; check and chain re-proved by the kernel in `cert`
report_tiers.census: PROVED at every depth (cert `gate_recursion`, Lean ptp_gate_full): rz/toffoli/x/h of the gate-level recursion = ptpResources (sandwich leaf, 1 Rz per cell); census.cnot EXCLUDES the split's sign-extension fan-out — the circuit's CNOT is `cnot_with_extension` (ptpCnotFull); `toffoli_uncompute` = And† (ptpAndDag), compute Toffoli (And) = toffoli - toffoli_uncompute
report_tiers.reserve_need_per_operand, clean_ancilla_: FORMULA (ForShor reserveNeed shape, private workspace per child). `qubits` (= ptpQubits) is proved only as a bound on the qubits the circuit NAMES (`LowGate.usedQubits`, `ptp_qubits_le_ptpQubits`); it is not a bound on the framework's qubitCount (named qubits + the model's clean scratch), for which see `ptp_peak_qubits` below. The constructed circuit of `gate_recursion` has a different, proved bound on the named qubits: <= 3n + ptpWorkspace (per level 3k·C' reserve, children share one pool, 2 leaf ancillas). `clean_ancilla_peak` is this suite's formula under its own cost convention; the method-aware scratch bound (ForShor `ptpCleanAnc`, `ptpCleanAncD`) is proved inside `ptp_peak_qubits`
report_tiers.census_ccphase_leaf, qubits_ccphase_leaf: FORMULA, documented alternative: the same with the CCPhase leaf (5 Rz per cell; ptpNodeCCPhase_resources, ptpResourcesCCPhase_depth_one)
report_tiers.census_exact, cnot_with_extension_exact,: FORMULA PROVED at every depth on the EXACT ladder (cert `gate_recursion_exact`, Lean ptp_gate_full_exact, --widths exact only): the gate-level recursion with every node's children at ptpTightWidth exists, is correct, and has rz/toffoli/x/h = ptpResourcesX, CNOT = ptpCnotFullX (extension fan-out included; census_exact.cnot excludes it), And† = ptpAndDagX, qubits <= 3n + ptpWorkspaceX; the NUMBERS at the target width are compiled evaluation (lean --run) of those formulas, not kernel-reduced; ptpResourcesD recurses exactly as ladderX (choose, ptpTightWidth < n), agreement by construction, not a theorem (HG7 F1/F2)
report_tiers.qubits_bound_scan: PROVED bound for the scan-ladder circuit of `gate_recursion` (3n + ptpWorkspace), on the named qubits only (no clean scratch)
report_tiers.ptp_peak_qubits: Lean-proved UPPER BOUND on the framework's qubitCount (named qubits + clean scratch), `ptpPeakQubits = 3n + ptpWsTD + ptpCleanAncD`: ForShor `ptp_peak_qubits` (any width rule), `ptp_peak_qubits_exact` (exact rule, the board's) and `ptp_peak_qubits_scan` (scan rule), Implementation/PhaseTripleProduct/Statement.lean (PTPPeakQubits*) at ForShor 21e129aeefc0fd1bbb8fa63402f5799af2490788. EXISTENTIAL, like PTPQubitsTight: some circuit following the policy has qubitCount <= the number; not an equality in general. ptpWsTD is the workspace the construction touches (base 2 + 3(k C' - w) per node), ptpCleanAncD the largest clean scratch of one node under the policy's `negation` (1 for `oneQubit`, C' + 1 for `scratch`). The number is evaluated here in Python (ptp_exact_width.ptp_peak_qubits) and cross-checked against ForShor's kernel-evaluated numerals (scripts/test_ptp_peak_qubits.py); the ForShor claims concern ForShor's own PTPPolicy on the same tables, not this suite's TableGeneration.PTP object. Not kernel-reduced in this suite's certificate.
